name: Terminal Desk
structure: Multi-panel desk: command line, four mnemonic panels (ORD blotter, RSN reasons, MSG conversation, MON desk), function-key bar.
logo: Amber block with the three-letter command WSL and a cursor bar; the door is the cursor gap.
icons: Mnemonic codes in boxes instead of pictograms (ORD, MSG, ADD, RES, QLT).
phone: One panel per screen, swipe between mnemonic panels; the command line is a bottom sheet.
messages: MSG panel: a scrolling tape of timestamped lines, customer lines in cyan, system lines in amber.
metrics: MON panel: key-value table, no charts; daily figures as a fixed grid of codes.

name: Golden Signals
structure: Variable bar, four signal stats, time-series rows following the data flow, drill-down table of the riskiest orders.
logo: A signal waveform that resolves into a door at its right edge.
icons: Thin line icons, 1.5px, rounded caps, panel-menu style.
voice: Neutral operations English: states a number and its threshold.
phone: Stat cards stack, each opens a full-screen panel with time-range chips.
messages: A compact event panel: log lines grouped by conversation, expandable.
metrics: Primary zone: four golden-signal stats plus time series; thresholds colour the numbers.

name: Blotter
structure: Menu bar, filter toolbar, full-width blotter with lifecycle-coloured rows, docked order ticket, colour legend.
logo: A ticket stub with a perforation, the perforation shaped as an arch.
icons: Small 16px bevelled toolbar glyphs with text labels beside them.
voice: Exact, procedural, past participles for states.
phone: Blotter becomes a two-line row list; the ticket is a bottom drawer.
messages: Messages tab inside the ticket, a plain chronological list.
metrics: A summary strip of counts under the blotter; results as a printable table.

name: Review Desk
structure: Open-review queue left, case right with evidence cards (customer's words, address check, history), reason bars, decision bar with J/K.
logo: A case-file tab with a magnifier ring whose lens is a door.
icons: Filled 20px icons with a 2px outline on active.
voice: Plain, evidential: 'Why this score', 'What the customer wrote'.
phone: Queue is the home; tapping a case slides the evidence full-screen with a sticky decision bar.
messages: Evidence card 'Customer's words' with highlighted phrases, plus the thread below.
metrics: Review throughput and decision split as two small panels on a Reports page.

name: Control Tower
structure: KPI strip, exceptions queue, central map coloured by risk, selected order panel.
logo: A route line leaving a pin and arriving at a door arch.
phone: Map on top, a pull-up sheet with the exception list.
messages: Exception card shows the last customer message and a quick reply.
metrics: KPI strip plus a regional breakdown table.

name: On-Call
structure: Incident groups by state, selected incident with action bar, timeline, runbook, on-call banner.
logo: A bell whose clapper is a doorway.
voice: Operational and personal: 'You are on call until 18:00'.
phone: Push-style incident cards with Acknowledge as the primary thumb action.
messages: Timeline combines customer messages and system events.
metrics: Analytics page: time to acknowledge and to resolve.

name: Dispatch
structure: Incident list, unit board (owner, assistant, couriers, LLM), event log, command line.
logo: A radio-bar mark: three ascending bars opening into an arch.
icons: Angular 2px stroke icons with square caps.
phone: Unit chips at top, incident cards below, command is a keyboard sheet.
messages: Event log with a narrative field, timestamped.
metrics: Shift summary: calls handled, response times, units idle.

name: Central Station
structure: Alarm banner, one channel per order with trace, large score, priority marker, silence control.
logo: A heartbeat line that ends in a door.
icons: Bold 24px pictograms in the clinical-device idiom.
phone: One channel per card, a persistent alarm bar that cannot be dismissed accidentally.
messages: Bedside note: the last customer message under the trace.

name: Grey Process
structure: Level bar, pipeline of equipment with analog range indicators, abnormal note.
logo: A pipe with one valve opening into an arch.
icons: Grey equipment symbols; only the abnormal one gains colour.
voice: Dry and factual; states only deviations.
phone: Level 2 overview only, tap equipment for level 3.
messages: Operator log, plain text, abnormal items first.
metrics: Analog indicator bars with alarm zones.

name: Scope
structure: Strip bay, scope with tracks and three-line data blocks, alert strip.
logo: A radar sweep whose centre is an arch.
icons: Track symbols (triangle, square, circle) as the icon system.
phone: Strip list as the home; the scope is a landscape-only view.
messages: Strip annotation field and a read-back log.

name: Inbox
structure: Views list, conversation list with SLA timers, thread with Wasel draft, internal notes and macros.
logo: A speech bubble with a clock hand forming an arch.
phone: Messaging-app pattern: list, thread, big reply box, SLA chip in the header.
messages: The product centre: bubbles, notes, macros.
metrics: SLA performance and reply times on a Reports page.

name: Back Office
structure: Global bar, side nav, index table with tabs, filter pills and bulk select, tone badges.
logo: A shopping-tag with a keyhole arch cut-out.
phone: Index becomes a card list with a bottom tab bar.
messages: Customer timeline on the order page.
metrics: Reports as cards with a date range.

name: Worklist
structure: Shell bar, worklist with KPI tags beside an object page (header facets, anchor tabs, footer action bar).
logo: An enterprise square mark with an inset arch.
phone: Object page full screen with a footer action bar.
messages: 'Messages' anchor tab on the object page.
metrics: KPI tags in the worklist header.

name: Batch Table
structure: UI shell, side nav, data table with toolbar and batch-action bar, density control, pagination.
logo: A grid cell with one cell opened into an arch.
phone: Responsive table collapses to a list with an overflow menu per row.

name: Wallboard
structure: Header with clock, six status cells, escalation ticker; no interaction.
logo: A bold block wordmark readable at ten metres, door as the O.
phone: Not a phone product: a TV mode and a 'send to screen' control.

name: Command Inbox
structure: Sidebar, state-grouped inbox with tiny priority marks, peek panel, command palette.
logo: A caret-and-slash command glyph whose slash is an arch.
phone: Inbox as a list with swipe actions; the palette is a sheet.
messages: Peek panel with the thread and keyboard replies.

name: Clear Desk
family: Hybrid: Terminal Desk structure, friendly light palette
src: owner decision after the persona rounds
structure: Terminal Desk's rigid panel grid and key row kept; light warm surface, plain words, search bar instead of command line, left queue beside the case, dark theme as a switch.
logo: Teal square carrying a W with a door arch, set on the same grid as the panels.
icons: Plain words on square keys, no codes.
voice: Plain sentences, sentence case, one primary action.
phone: One order per card, filter pills on top, one big primary button.
messages: Quote cards with the highlighted phrase and a one-line explanation of why it was highlighted.
metrics: Key-value panels, number first, one sentence under it.
